capabilities: Push notes and their linked attachments from chosen vault folders to a trip2g server
Pull server-side edits back into the vault with optional two-way sync and live pull
Resolve sync conflicts by keeping the local version, the server version or both
Filter pushed notes by a frontmatter field such as publish: true
Open or copy a note's published URL from the status bar, note menu or command palette
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a general vault-sync tool; syncing is the means to publish notes on a trip2g server.
extras: The README warns to back up the vault before enabling two-way sync, notes the API key is stored in plain text in data.json, and says to install only one of the two plugin copies (ttgsync or trip2g) in a vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish selected vault notes to a self-hosted website with private subscribers, version history and editing from the server side.

relations.evidence: This plugin syncs a folder of your Obsidian vault with your own trip2g server, which publishes the notes as a website.
So the Obsidian Git plugin can do part of this plugin's job.

requires.name: API key from the server's admin panel

summary: Syncs vault folders with a self-hosted trip2g server that publishes the notes as a website, with two-way sync, conflict resolution and live pull.
